title: State euf lemma facts only for nodes outside their folded ites
summary: euf theory lemmas whose ite terms stay folded now state facts only about terms outside those ites, as array lemmas already did. Theorem statements and tactics are unchanged; on dlx-regfile the euf lemmas shrink from 1.75 MB to 0.72 MB and Lean checks the theory lemmas in 19 s instead of 27 s.
